title: Care Desk Guidance: Household Discounts on Tailwise Grooming Salon Passes
content:
Pass purchases at the Tailwise Grooming Salon look across the household. Three discounts exist on a pass purchase, and only one of them is ever applied.

**The rule**

1. A pass bought while another pass of the same customer for a different pet is in status active qualifies for the multi-pet discount.
2. A pet with a Tailwise Vet Clinic wellness plan in status active qualifies for the wellness-plan discount.
3. A pass bought online qualifies for the online discount.
4. Only one of these discounts is applied, the largest. Equal discounts apply in the order multi-pet, wellness plan, online, and the one applied is recorded on the pass as its discount.
5. No discount applies to Groom Club Monthly fees, and coupons are not accepted on passes.

**Discount rates by pass (percent)**

| Pass | Multi-pet | Wellness plan | Online |
|---|---|---|---|
| Express Bath Pass 3-Visit | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit | 5 | 0 | 0 |
| Full Groom Pass 4-Visit | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit | 10 | 5 | 5 |
| Groom Club Monthly | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Which discount is applied (hypothetical purchases)**

| Pass bought | Qualifies for | Applied and recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Full Groom Pass 6-Visit, online, pet on an active wellness plan, no other active pass in the household | wellness plan 5, online 5 | wellness plan, 5 percent (equal rates; wellness plan comes before online) |
| Spa Groom Pass 6-Visit at the salon, sibling dog holds an active pass, pet on an active wellness plan | multi-pet 10, wellness plan 5 | multi-pet, 10 percent (the largest) |
| Groom Club Monthly joined online while a sibling pet holds an active pass | — | none; no discount applies to club fees |

**Points of judgement**

- The multi-pet test looks at another pass of the same customer for a *different* pet, in status active at the time of purchase.
- The wellness-plan test looks at the pet the pass is being bought for and its Tailwise Vet Clinic wellness plan in status active.
- A coupon offered by the customer is not accepted on any pass.
